# 2. Load Annotation (Shared Across All Timepoints)

## 2.1 Set Working Directory

```{r set_wd}
# UPDATE: All files are in the same folder
setwd("/Users/andrew20445/Desktop/To_do_list/RNAseq_data/New_salmon_round2")
cat("Working directory:", getwd(), "\n")
```

## 2.2 Load Sclerotinia GO Annotation

```{r load_annotation}
cat("\n=== LOADING SCLEROTINIA GO ANNOTATION ===\n\n")

go_file <- "./Sclsc1_GeneCatalog_proteins_20110903_GO.tab"

if(!file.exists(go_file)) {
  stop("❌ GO annotation file not found: ", go_file)
}

go_annot <- read.delim(go_file, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("✓ Loaded GO annotation file\n")
cat("  Rows:", nrow(go_annot), "\n")
cat("  Unique protein IDs:", length(unique(go_annot$X.proteinId)), "\n")
cat("  Unique GO terms:", length(unique(go_annot$goAcc)), "\n")
```

## 2.3 Create GO-to-Gene Mapping

```{r create_go_mapping}
# term2gene: GO term → gene mapping
term2gene <- data.frame(
  GO = go_annot$goAcc,
  GeneID = as.character(go_annot$X.proteinId),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# term2name: GO term → GO name
term2name <- data.frame(
  GO = go_annot$goAcc,
  Name = go_annot$goName,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  distinct(GO, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("✓ Created term2gene mapping:", nrow(term2gene), "GO-gene pairs\n")
cat("✓ Created term2name mapping:", nrow(term2name), "GO terms\n")
```

## 2.4 Define Helper Functions

```{r helper_functions}
# Extract protein ID from JGI format: Ss_jgi|Sclsc1|PROTEIN_ID|GENE_NAME
extract_protein_id <- function(jgi_ids) {
  sapply(jgi_ids, function(id) {
    parts <- strsplit(id, "\\|")[[1]]
    if(length(parts) >= 3) {
      return(as.numeric(parts[3]))
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# Extract gene names for reference
extract_gene_name <- function(jgi_ids) {
  sapply(jgi_ids, function(id) {
    parts <- strsplit(id, "\\|")[[1]]
    if(length(parts) >= 4) {
      return(parts[4])
    } else {
      return(NA)
    }
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# Run enrichment and return result (or NULL)
run_enrichment <- function(gene_list, term2gene, term2name, label) {
  if(length(gene_list) < 10) {
    cat(sprintf("  ⚠️ %s: Not enough genes (%d, need ≥10) — skipped\n", label, length(gene_list)))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  ego <- enricher(
    gene = gene_list,
    TERM2GENE = term2gene,
    TERM2NAME = term2name,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500
  )
  
  if(!is.null(ego) && nrow(ego@result) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  ✓ %s: %d enriched GO terms\n", label, nrow(ego@result)))
    return(ego)
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  ⚠️ %s: No significantly enriched terms found\n", label))
    return(NULL)
  }
}

cat("✓ Helper functions defined\n")
```

# 3. GO Enrichment — Loop Over All Timepoints

```{r define_timepoints}
timepoints <- c("24h", "48h", "96h")

# Master list to store all results
all_results <- list()

cat("Will analyze timepoints:", paste(timepoints, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r enrichment_loop, results='asis', fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
for (tp in timepoints) {
  
  # ── Section header ──
  cat("\n\n---\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("## 3.%s GO Enrichment at %s {.tabset}\n\n", 
              match(tp, timepoints), tp))
  
  cat(sprintf("\n=== PROCESSING TIMEPOINT: %s ===\n\n", tp))
  
  # ── Load DEG file ──
  # NOTE: Files are in the SAME directory (./), not parent (../)
  deg_file <- sprintf("./Ha_pathogen_aggressive_vs_low_DEGs_%s.csv", tp)
  
  if(!file.exists(deg_file)) {
    cat(sprintf("❌ DEG file not found: %s — SKIPPING\n", deg_file))
    next
  }
  
  pathogen_degs <- read.csv(deg_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = 1)
  cat(sprintf("✓ Loaded %d DEGs from %s\n", nrow(pathogen_degs), basename(deg_file)))
  
  # ── Fix gene IDs: extract protein IDs ──
  original_gene_ids <- rownames(pathogen_degs)
  pathogen_degs$protein_id <- extract_protein_id(original_gene_ids)
  pathogen_degs$gene_name <- extract_gene_name(original_gene_ids)
  pathogen_degs$original_gene_id <- original_gene_ids
  
  cat(sprintf("  Protein IDs extracted: %d / %d\n", 
              sum(!is.na(pathogen_degs$protein_id)), nrow(pathogen_degs)))
  
  # ── Check annotation coverage ──
  deg_protein_ids <- unique(as.character(pathogen_degs$protein_id[!is.na(pathogen_degs$protein_id)]))
  annot_protein_ids <- unique(term2gene$GeneID)
  overlap_ids <- intersect(deg_protein_ids, annot_protein_ids)
  
  coverage_pct <- round(100 * length(overlap_ids) / length(deg_protein_ids), 1)
  cat(sprintf("  Annotation coverage: %d / %d genes (%.1f%%)\n", 
              length(overlap_ids), length(deg_protein_ids), coverage_pct))
  
  if(length(overlap_ids) == 0) {
    cat("  ❌ No overlap — skipping this timepoint\n")
    next
  }
  
  # ── Separate up/down-regulated ──
  lfc_col <- grep("log.*fold|lfc", colnames(pathogen_degs), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  
  upregulated   <- pathogen_degs[pathogen_degs[[lfc_col]] > 0, ]
  downregulated <- pathogen_degs[pathogen_degs[[lfc_col]] < 0, ]
  
  cat(sprintf("  Up-regulated: %d | Down-regulated: %d\n\n", 
              nrow(upregulated), nrow(downregulated)))
  
  # ── Prepare gene lists ──
  all_genes_list  <- as.character(pathogen_degs$protein_id[!is.na(pathogen_degs$protein_id)])
  up_genes_list   <- as.character(upregulated$protein_id[!is.na(upregulated$protein_id)])
  down_genes_list <- as.character(downregulated$protein_id[!is.na(downregulated$protein_id)])
  
  # ── Run enrichments ──
  cat("Running enrichment analysis...\n")
  ego_all  <- run_enrichment(all_genes_list,  term2gene, term2name, "All DEGs")
  ego_up   <- run_enrichment(up_genes_list,   term2gene, term2name, "Up-regulated")
  ego_down <- run_enrichment(down_genes_list, term2gene, term2name, "Down-regulated")
  
  # ── Store results ──
  all_results[[tp]] <- list(
    degs = pathogen_degs,
    ego_all = ego_all,
    ego_up = ego_up,
    ego_down = ego_down,
    n_up = nrow(upregulated),
    n_down = nrow(downregulated),
    coverage = coverage_pct
  )
  
  # ── Plots ──
  
  # Dot plot — All DEGs
  if(!is.null(ego_all) && nrow(ego_all@result) > 0) {
    p1 <- dotplot(ego_all, showCategory = 20, font.size = 10) +
      ggtitle(paste0("GO Enrichment — Pathogen DEGs in Sunflower (", tp, ")")) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
    print(p1)
  }
  
  # Dot plot — Up vs Down side by side
  if(!is.null(ego_up) && !is.null(ego_down)) {
    if(nrow(ego_up@result) > 0 && nrow(ego_down@result) > 0) {
      p_up <- dotplot(ego_up, showCategory = 15, font.size = 9) +
        ggtitle(paste0("Up-regulated (", tp, ")")) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
      
      p_down <- dotplot(ego_down, showCategory = 15, font.size = 9) +
        ggtitle(paste0("Down-regulated (", tp, ")")) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
      
      print(plot_grid(p_up, p_down, ncol = 1))
    }
  } else if(!is.null(ego_up) && nrow(ego_up@result) > 0) {
    p_up <- dotplot(ego_up, showCategory = 15, font.size = 9) +
      ggtitle(paste0("Up-regulated (", tp, ")")) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
    print(p_up)
  } else if(!is.null(ego_down) && nrow(ego_down@result) > 0) {
    p_down <- dotplot(ego_down, showCategory = 15, font.size = 9) +
      ggtitle(paste0("Down-regulated (", tp, ")")) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
    print(p_down)
  }
  
  # Bar plot — All DEGs
  if(!is.null(ego_all) && nrow(ego_all@result) > 0) {
    p2 <- barplot(ego_all, showCategory = 20) +
      ggtitle(paste0("Top 20 Enriched GO Terms (", tp, ")")) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
    print(p2)
  }
  
  # Gene-Concept Network — category labels only
  if(!is.null(ego_all) && nrow(ego_all@result) > 0) {
    p3 <- cnetplot(ego_all, 
                   showCategory = 5, 
                   colorEdge = TRUE, 
                   circular = FALSE,
                   node_label = "category") +
      ggtitle(paste0("Gene-Concept Network — Top 5 Terms (", tp, ")")) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
    print(p3)
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("\n✓ Timepoint %s complete\n", tp))
}
```

# 4. Cross-Timepoint Comparison

```{r cross_timepoint_summary}
cat("\n=== CROSS-TIMEPOINT SUMMARY ===\n\n")

summary_df <- data.frame(
  Timepoint = character(),
  Total_DEGs = integer(),
  Up = integer(),
  Down = integer(),
  Coverage_pct = numeric(),
  GO_all = integer(),
  GO_up = integer(),
  GO_down = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (tp in names(all_results)) {
  r <- all_results[[tp]]
  summary_df <- rbind(summary_df, data.frame(
    Timepoint = tp,
    Total_DEGs = nrow(r$degs),
    Up = r$n_up,
    Down = r$n_down,
    Coverage_pct = r$coverage,
    GO_all  = ifelse(!is.null(r$ego_all),  nrow(r$ego_all@result),  0),
    GO_up   = ifelse(!is.null(r$ego_up),   nrow(r$ego_up@result),   0),
    GO_down = ifelse(!is.null(r$ego_down), nrow(r$ego_down@result), 0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

print(summary_df)
```

```{r compare_go_terms, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# Collect enriched GO term IDs across timepoints
go_terms_by_tp <- list()
for (tp in names(all_results)) {
  r <- all_results[[tp]]
  if(!is.null(r$ego_all) && nrow(r$ego_all@result) > 0) {
    sig <- r$ego_all@result[r$ego_all@result$pvalue < 0.05, ]
    go_terms_by_tp[[tp]] <- sig$ID
  } else {
    go_terms_by_tp[[tp]] <- character(0)
  }
}

# Show overlap counts
if(length(go_terms_by_tp) >= 2) {
  cat("\n=== GO TERM OVERLAP ACROSS TIMEPOINTS ===\n\n")
  
  for (i in 1:(length(go_terms_by_tp) - 1)) {
    for (j in (i+1):length(go_terms_by_tp)) {
      tp_i <- names(go_terms_by_tp)[i]
      tp_j <- names(go_terms_by_tp)[j]
      shared <- length(intersect(go_terms_by_tp[[tp_i]], go_terms_by_tp[[tp_j]]))
      cat(sprintf("  %s ∩ %s: %d shared GO terms\n", tp_i, tp_j, shared))
    }
  }
  
  if(length(go_terms_by_tp) == 3) {
    shared_all <- Reduce(intersect, go_terms_by_tp)
    cat(sprintf("  All three timepoints: %d shared GO terms\n", length(shared_all)))
    
    if(length(shared_all) > 0) {
      cat("\nGO terms enriched at ALL timepoints:\n")
      shared_names <- term2name[term2name$GO %in% shared_all, ]
      print(shared_names)
    }
  }
}
```

# 5. Save Results

```{r save_results}
cat("\n=== SAVING ENRICHMENT RESULTS ===\n\n")

output_dir <- "./Ha_sclerotinia_pathogen_enrichment_all_timepoints"
if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  cat("✓ Created output directory:", output_dir, "\n\n")
}

for (tp in names(all_results)) {
  r <- all_results[[tp]]
  
  cat(sprintf("--- Saving %s results ---\n", tp))
  
  if(!is.null(r$ego_all) && nrow(r$ego_all@result) > 0) {
    fname <- sprintf("Ha_pathogen_all_DEGs_GO_enrichment_%s.csv", tp)
    write.csv(r$ego_all@result, file.path(output_dir, fname), row.names = FALSE)
    cat("  ✓", fname, "\n")
  }
  
  if(!is.null(r$ego_up) && nrow(r$ego_up@result) > 0) {
    fname <- sprintf("Ha_pathogen_upregulated_GO_enrichment_%s.csv", tp)
    write.csv(r$ego_up@result, file.path(output_dir, fname), row.names = FALSE)
    cat("  ✓", fname, "\n")
  }
  
  if(!is.null(r$ego_down) && nrow(r$ego_down@result) > 0) {
    fname <- sprintf("Ha_pathogen_downregulated_GO_enrichment_%s.csv", tp)
    write.csv(r$ego_down@result, file.path(output_dir, fname), row.names = FALSE)
    cat("  ✓", fname, "\n")
  }
  
  fname <- sprintf("Ha_pathogen_DEGs_with_protein_ids_%s.csv", tp)
  write.csv(r$degs, file.path(output_dir, fname), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("  ✓", fname, "\n")
}

write.csv(summary_df, file.path(output_dir, "cross_timepoint_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n✓ Saved: cross_timepoint_summary.csv\n")

cat("\nAll results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
```

# 6. Summary

```{r summary}
cat("\n=== SUNFLOWER PATHOGEN GO ENRICHMENT SUMMARY ===\n\n")

cat("Timepoints analyzed:", paste(names(all_results), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

for (tp in names(all_results)) {
  r <- all_results[[tp]]
  cat(sprintf("─── %s ───\n", tp))
  cat(sprintf("  DEGs: %d (Up: %d, Down: %d)\n", nrow(r$degs), r$n_up, r$n_down))
  cat(sprintf("  Annotation coverage: %.1f%%\n", r$coverage))
  
  n_all  <- ifelse(!is.null(r$ego_all),  nrow(r$ego_all@result),  0)
  n_up   <- ifelse(!is.null(r$ego_up),   nrow(r$ego_up@result),   0)
  n_down <- ifelse(!is.null(r$ego_down), nrow(r$ego_down@result), 0)
  
  cat(sprintf("  Enriched GO terms: All=%d, Up=%d, Down=%d\n\n", n_all, n_up, n_down))
}

cat("✓ Analysis complete!\n")
```
